areas.name: Environmental sustainability, adaptation and mitigation
areas.reason: Program integrates environmental and climate-resilience concerns into road asset management, preventing disasters via drainage, slope protection and recovery of environmental liabilities.

areas.name: Public-service delivery, management and citizen participation
areas.reason: Long-term performance-based contracting model improves road service delivery, cuts costs and improves public spending management.

areas.name: Energy efficiency and renewable energy
areas.reason: Energy-transition and modal-shift studies are mentioned, but no actions directly address energy efficiency or renewables.

areas.name: Basic sanitation
areas.reason: Restoring drainage devices is mentioned, but no actions directly implement or expand basic sanitation.

areas.name: Integrated water-resources management and water security
areas.reason: Erosion and water-body damage reduction belongs to climate resilience, not directly to water security.

areas.name: Biodiversity and forest resources
areas.reason: Environmental awareness and good practices are mentioned, but no actions directly address biodiversity or forest conservation.

areas.name: Business environment and opportunities
areas.reason: Infrastructure improvement raises regional competitiveness, but no actions directly improve the business environment.

areas.name: Individual entrepreneurs and micro/small firms
areas.reason: Competitiveness gains are mentioned, but no actions directly benefit individual entrepreneurs or micro and small firms.

areas.name: Jobs and income for low-income and vulnerable groups
areas.reason: Direct and indirect construction jobs are mentioned, but no actions directly aim at employment and income generation.

areas.name: Infrastructure and social facilities for low-income and vulnerable groups
areas.reason: Transport infrastructure in a socioeconomically selected region, but nothing directly aimed at low-income and vulnerable populations.

areas.name: Inclusion of social minorities
areas.reason: Sustainable tourism in traditional or indigenous areas is mentioned, but alignment with the entity's legal mandate and sector plan was not clarified.

areas.name: Youth, gender and race policies
areas.reason: Jobs targeted at a specific population are mentioned, but no actions directly address youth, gender or race policies.

areas.name: Education and health conditions
areas.reason: Road-safety actions to cut fatalities are mentioned, but nothing directly tied to education or health.

areas.name: Technological development, innovation and modernization
areas.reason: Institutional strengthening of infrastructure management is mentioned, but no actions directly address technological development or innovation.

areas.name: Financing arrangements encouraging private participation
areas.reason: Support for transport and concession policy reform is mentioned, but the program has no financing arrangements directly promoting private participation.
